english.note: Use this for the transmission of a disease, and figuratively for habits or behaviour spreading through a household or community.
Use this for the process or act of passing an infection from one host to another.

examples.english: The contagion of flu spreads quickly among family members, so everyone needs to be careful.
examples.traditional: 流感喺屋企人之間傳染得好快，大家都要小心。
examples.jyutping: lau4 gam2 hai2 uk1 kei2 jan4 zi1 gaan1 cyun4 jim5 dak1 hou2 faai3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 jiu3 siu2 sam1

examples.english: The flu can easily pass an infection on to your family.
examples.traditional: 流感好容易傳染畀屋企人。
examples.jyutping: lau4 gam2 hou2 jung4 ji6 cyun4 jim5 bei2 uk1 kei2 jan4
